responsibility: Implements the scanning layer of GCC’s RTL dataflow engine: it walks RTL insns and artificial entry/exit uses/defs to build and maintain df_ref, df_insn_info, df_reg_info, and multiword hard-register records. The file owns allocation pools and reg/insn chains for defs, uses, and equiv uses, incremental install/delete/rescan support, hard-register liveness side data such as regs_ever_live, and full verification routines that rescan RTL and check consistency between per-insn refs, artificial refs, bitmaps, and per-register chains.
